components.name: SidePanel
components.description:
Figma Side-Panel (1573:3128). Standard: a full-height Surface column with a 1px Border/Neutral/Pale left edge, rendered
in place (the page layout docks it); Escape closes it (from the panel or the page beside it) and focus returns to the
opener. Modal: a floating Background/Container panel (Corner-Radius/XLarge, Container
border, Effect/Container) 8px from the viewport edge over the scrim; focus is trapped and returns to the opener.
Sections, each Modal-Padding on every side: Top-Customize (optional) · Header (Header-Contents, gap XSmall: the row
back · title (Standard Heading/3, Modal Heading/4) · close, gap Medium; caption; more header content) · Contents
(gap Medium, scrolls) · Modal/Actions footer.

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the overlay is shown: keep it in state and set it from `onOpenChange` (the exit animation then plays).
Without `open` the overlay shows while it is mounted, e.g. `{show && <Dialog … />}`.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false on Escape, a scrim click, the close button, or an action without its own handler.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called at the same moments as `onOpenChange(false)`: the overlay asks to close.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the title: 2 (default, an h2), or 1 / 3 to fit the page outline. Only the tag changes, not the text style.

props.name: headerContent
props.description: Figma Header-Contents slot: more header content under the caption (a status row, tabs, a search field), gap XSmall.

props.name: top
props.description: Figma Top-Customize slot, rendered above the header (e.g. a Stepper, a banner or a cover).

props.name: onBack
props.description:
Figma Back-Container: a back button (Button/Icon-Flat Small, icon-arrow-narrow-left-line) before the title, for a
 panel that drilled into a detail. Called on click; without it there is no back button.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the back button. Default: the locale's “Back”.

props.name: type
props.description: Figma Type: Standard (docked beside the page, non-modal) · Modal (floating over a scrim, traps focus).

props.name: icon
props.deprecated:
Figma's Side-Panel no longer draws a heading icon (removed on 2026-10-12). Modal only: a 44px icon above
 the title, still drawn for now; put an icon in `top` or `headerContent` instead.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Escape / scrim click close a modal panel (default true).

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default: the locale's “Close panel”.

props.name: overrides
props.description:
Figma instance overrides: props of the back and close buttons and action Buttons it draws, by layer (`{ "Actions/Primary": { level: "accent" }, Close: { level: "secondary" } }`). Written by Zen Studio;
 app code sets onBack / the actions.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the panel `<aside>` element; set while the panel is open.
